headline: Silver Falls 3.9 Percent To $50.15 As Oil Rises 1.99 Percent To $104.03
narrative: Silver fell 3.9 percent to $50.15 and gold fell 1.42 percent to $3,974.20, money leaving the precious-metals pipe in the same session. That pipe is the hard-asset bid, and both declines mean sellers had gold and silver. Oil rose 1.99 percent to $104.03, the energy pipe taking that bid, while copper fell 1.43 percent to $6.49.
author: jordan
